/.description: Allevor builds practical workflow automations for small and medium-sized businesses.
h2: From repetitive task to automated system.
p: We build lightweight automations that take repetitive work off your team’s plate.
Built for small businesses. Designed around the way you actually work.
Small, useful automations for the everyday work that shouldn’t need someone watching it.
Automatically collect, process and respond to customer feedback.
Trigger timely, personalized follow-up messages without manual work.
Handle repetitive first-response workflows for incoming leads.
Connect forms, notifications, documents and other repetitive internal tasks.
Build a workflow around a specific repetitive process in your business.
A simple response system that keeps customers heard and the right people informed.
We identify the repetitive process that is consuming time.
We map the workflow and determine what should happen automatically.
We build and test the automation around the existing business process.
The system handles the repetitive work while the business stays in control.
Problem: feedback arrives, but follow-up is inconsistent and insights are easy to miss.
Workflow: survey → response → routing → personalized email → relevant notification.
Automated result: the right response happens without another repetitive handoff.
New response  →  Review needed  →  Notify owner

We don’t believe every business needs a giant software implementation. We focus on small, practical systems that solve a specific problem, integrate into the way you already work, and can improve over time.
Practical — Solve the actual problem, not the buzzword.
Lightweight — Build only what is necessary.
Built to evolve — Start small and expand when the workflow proves its value.
An independent automation studio focused on making everyday business processes simpler.
We work with businesses internationally, designing practical systems around real processes—not generic playbooks.
